# Orthopedics treatment cost in India for patients from United Kingdom

**In short:** Orthopedic surgery in India offers UK patients significant savings, shorter waiting times, and access to internationally accredited hospitals for procedures like knee and hip replacements.

## Why patients from United Kingdom choose India

- **Significant cost savings:** Save thousands compared to UK private treatment, often paying a fraction of the price for the same procedures.
- **Accredited hospitals:** We work with JCI- and NABH-accredited facilities that maintain high international standards of clinical care and patient safety.
- **Shorter waiting times:** Avoid long NHS queues and get access to surgery and specialist consultations much faster.
- **Experienced surgeons:** Orthopedic specialists in India frequently have global training and extensive experience in joint replacement and sports medicine.

## Orthopedic treatment cost comparison

|---|---|---|

## Frequently asked questions

**Is it safe to have orthopedic surgery in India?**
Yes. We only facilitate treatment at hospitals that hold recognized international accreditations like JCI and NABH, ensuring high standards of hygiene, safety, and clinical governance.

**How long do I need to stay in India?**
Typically, you should plan to stay for 2 to 3 weeks, depending on the procedure and your recovery speed. Your surgeon will give you a specific timeline before you travel.

**How do I pay for the treatment?**
Payments are made directly to the hospital. We do not handle your medical funds. We only charge a separate, transparent facilitation fee for our support services.
